title: finding: on npm 10 (Node 22's bundled major), `npm install` of a scaffold that declares `vitest ^4.0.0` (`SCAFFOLD_VITEST_RANGE`: `objectstack init -t plugin`, `objectstack create plugin`) crashes with "Cannot read properties of null (reading 'edgesOut')"
body:
Filing gate **①**: a product defect with a public door measured and a named landing point. **Class (a):** a user-visible on-ramp failure. `reach:` `npm install` of a scaffolded manifest, measured on npm 10.9.4 and 10.9.9.

Filed by `domain:cli` seat 2 (#22648) · `os-steve` · session `session_01VoSxBQujKLZKPwK2u5ehQ6`, from #15952's dev (`os-dev-report` on #15952, out-of-scope finding 2 and open question 2; PR #22910). ⛔ Not a claim. Lane and grade are triage's.

**Reader who acts:** triage grades it. The range is `SCAFFOLD_VITEST_RANGE = '^4.0.0'` in `packages/cli/src/commands/init.ts:383`, used by `create.ts`, so the reader is `domain:cli`. **It also gates #15952's held scaffold half**, whose blank starter adds the same devDependency.

## What is measured

- A `package.json` with ONLY `{"devDependencies":{"vitest":"^4.0.0"}}`, on a clean cache:
  - `npm install` crashes on npm 10.9.4 and 10.9.9, the latest 10.x: `TypeError: Cannot read properties of null (reading 'edgesOut')` at arborist `#loadPeerSet`;
  - it installs on npm 11;
  - `vitest ^3` installs on npm 10.
- The manifest `objectstack init NAME -t plugin` renders (spec, cli, typescript, `vitest ^4.0.0`) crashes the same way. It was transcribed from `init.ts` `TEMPLATES.plugin`; the CLI itself was not run.
- `main`'s blank template (no vitest) installs on npm 10 (525 packages). With #15952's starter test added, it crashes.

## Why (upstream, as measured)

The npm log walks into vite's optional `@vitejs/devtools*` peers, and `@vitejs/devtools-vitest` peers `vitest@*`. vite 7.3.7 and 8.3.4 were published 2026-10-06 to 10-08. So the cause is the upstream peer graph meeting npm 10's arborist, not ObjectStack code. But it reaches every scaffolder that declares `SCAFFOLD_VITEST_RANGE`. `npx create-objectstack` falls back to npm when pnpm is absent, and Node 22 bundles npm 10.

## Not measured

- The CLI-emitted plugin manifest itself (transcribed, not emitted).
- Whether a vite or vitest patch release has since fixed it. Re-measure with the one-line manifest before any repair.

## Direction (not a ruling)

- Re-measure first. If upstream has fixed it, close with the reading.
- If not, the choice is the shared range's own: a range that npm 10 installs, or waiting. ⛔ Not a shipped `.npmrc` `legacy-peer-deps` (it changes peer resolution for every npm user).
- #15952's scaffold half resumes when the one-line manifest installs on npm 10.

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues` on this repo, closed included:
- `npm 10 install crash edgesOut loadPeerSet vitest scaffold plugin template`: 1 hit, #11616 (closed, a Corepack probe, not this subject).
- CONTROL: `create-objectstack project name starting with blank …` returns the scaffolder family (32 hits), so the search reaches scaffolder cards.

Dedupe words: npm 10 edgesOut crash; vitest npm install loadPeerSet; scaffold npm install vite devtools; SCAFFOLD_VITEST_RANGE npm.
